leakageClassification.rule: Outcome, expectancy, score-state and future-state columns are raw/label evidence only and prohibited for same-game pregame feature use.

playerMapping.note: Pitcher/batter source IDs are preserved; canonical player mapping is deferred if production provider IDs lack MLBAM IDs.

importerDesign.durableProgressUnit: source file + file sha256 + row offset + batch index

checkpointResumeContract.unit: file + row offset/batch + source file digest

storageEstimate.method: bounded estimate from 2025 source file bytes and full-row JSONB preservation
storageEstimate.estimatedTableAndRawPayload: approximately 1.0-1.8 GB before indexes, depending on JSONB compression/toast behavior
storageEstimate.estimatedIndexes: approximately 250-600 MB for primary key, unique pitch identity, event/date, pitcher/date, batter/date and mapping indexes
storageEstimate.expectedIngestDuration: tens of minutes; depends on Supabase network/write throughput and conflict-read batching
storageEstimate.dbIndexConsiderations: Use 1000-row write batches, retry bounded transient failures, and monitor unique constraint conflicts by batch.
